'''Arleyk Smaugan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She worked a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] at the [[Strike Team Oricon camp]].
